verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email and calendar service, so sharing availability or bookable meeting times in an email is a fair question for it. The pack, however, has no evidence of such a feature. The only calendar items are a bare help-article title, "Calendar events and invitations", and community remarks about calendar syncing and a calendar UI bug. None of these documents availability sharing or booking links inserted into an email.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
